categories.name: Card Games
categories.blurb: Solitaire, poker, trick-taking and classic family card games.

categories.name: Hidden Object Games
categories.blurb: Search richly drawn scenes for clues, curios and lost treasures.

categories.name: Arcade
categories.blurb: Quick-reflex action, high scores and retro-style fun.

categories.name: Puzzle
categories.blurb: Tile matchers, logic puzzles and brain teasers.

categories.name: Word/Trivia
categories.blurb: Word games, crosswords and trivia challenges.

categories.name: Simulation
categories.blurb: Build, manage and live out a life of your own.

categories.name: Idle
categories.blurb: Click, collect, upgrade and watch the numbers climb.

categories.name: Education
categories.blurb: Learn something new while you play.

categories.name: Board Games
categories.blurb: Classic strategy and tile games for the kitchen table.

games.title: Klondike
games.subtitle: Gold Rush Solitaire
games.description: Stake your claim on Bonanza Creek. Classic Klondike solitaire with Draw One or Draw Three, a hand-drawn Yukon deck and original frontier music.

games.title: Texas Hold'em
games.subtitle: Pecos Creek Saloon
games.description: No-limit Texas Hold'em against Dusty Walker, Miss Lula Mae and Cody Briggs at a Southern saloon table. Play money only: chips have no cash value.

games.title: Blackjack
games.subtitle: The Gold Room
games.description: Player vs. dealer at a green-felt casino table with gold trim. Single deck, double deck or a 6-deck shoe; hit, stand, double down and split. Play money only.

games.title: Go Fish
games.subtitle: Loon Lake
games.description: A calm lakeside Go Fish game. Ask Grandpa Walt, Captain Rosie and Little Finn for cards at dawn on Loon Lake, and collect the most sets of four.

games.title: Old Maid
games.subtitle: Victorian Parlor
games.description: Pair your cards, pass them round the parlor and don't be left holding the Old Maid. Play against Lady Agatha, Colonel Bramble and Miss Pettigrew in a candlelit Victorian parlor.

games.title: Euchre
games.subtitle: Kitchen Table
games.description: Partner up with Aunt Barb against Uncle Dale and Grandma June. Call trump, play your bowers and euchre 'em. Polka music and popcorn included.

games.title: Hearts
games.subtitle: Trick-Taking
games.description: Dodge the hearts and the Queen of Spades, or shoot the moon.

games.title: Spades
games.subtitle: Trick-Taking
games.description: Bid your tricks with a partner. Spades are always trump.

games.title: Cribbage
games.subtitle: Board & Cards
games.description: Count fifteens, pairs and runs, and peg your way to 121.

games.title: Gin Rummy
games.subtitle: Rummy
games.description: Build melds, knock early, or go for gin.

games.title: Maple Lane Finds
games.subtitle: Cozy Hidden Object
games.description: A cozy autumn hidden-object game. Wander a pumpkin patch, a harvest barn, a little bakery, a corn maze and a fall fair, find ten hidden items in each, then relax with five puzzles. No timers in Relaxed mode.

games.title: Solar Siege
games.subtitle: Arcade Shooter
games.description: Defend the solar system from an alien invasion across nine planets, from Mercury to Pluto, with power-ups and a boss battle on Pluto.

games.title: Snugfit
games.subtitle: Jigsaw Puzzles
games.description: Relaxing jigsaw puzzles with freshly cut pieces every game. Ten puzzles to start, including the October Collection, in four sizes from about 100 to 1,000 pieces. Progress saves automatically.

games.title: Word & Trivia Games
games.subtitle: New category
games.description: Word games and trivia challenges are on the way.

games.title: Rewind Life
games.subtitle: Life Simulator
games.description: Maple Grove, 1986. Live day to day in a retro life simulator: nine houses, Main Street, the mall, school, jobs, holidays, cars and a running clock with needs to look after. This free demo is an early playable slice of the game.

games.title: Lifeboat Simulator
games.subtitle: Survival Simulator
games.description: Adrift at sea with only a lifeboat and what you can salvage. Ration your supplies, ride out the weather and hold on until rescue.

games.title: Prison Cell Simulator
games.subtitle: Life Simulator
games.description: Make the most of life inside four walls. Keep to the routine, pass the time and serve out your sentence one day at a time.

games.title: Big Top Builder
games.subtitle: Circus Management Sim
games.description: Build the greatest show on your turf. Raise tents, hire acrobats, jugglers and clowns, plan each show for the biggest crowd reaction, keep your guests fed and happy, then pack up the wagons and take your circus on tour.

games.title: Dookie Clicker
games.subtitle: Idle Clicker
games.description: Ironite's silly idle clicker. Click, collect and upgrade your way to the top. Plays online in its own window, so there's nothing to install.

games.title: The Appalachian Trail
games.subtitle: Educational Adventure
games.description: Hike the Appalachian Trail from Georgia to Maine. Plan your supplies, follow the white blazes and learn about the mountains, history and wildlife along the way.

games.title: Chess
games.subtitle: Ravenscroft Library
games.description: Play six opponents at the Ravenscroft Library, from Pip the Page to the Old Master, or a friend on the same computer. Full rules, clocks, hints and game review.

games.title: Mahjong
games.subtitle: Tile Matching
games.description: Match pairs of tiles to clear the board in this relaxing classic.

games.title: Checkers
games.subtitle: Hollow Creek General Store
games.description: American checkers in an old country store, against six regulars from Little Tucker to Old Gus, or a friend. Three boards, three piece sets and old-time music.
